The catalogs are an official publication of WPI. The rules, regulations, policies, fees and other charges, courses of study, and academic requirements that appear in this catalog were in effect at the time of its publication.
Whether noted elsewhere in these catalogs or not, the university reserves the right to change, eliminate, and add to any existing (and to introduce additional) rules, regulations, policies, fees and other charges, courses of study and academic requirements that appear in this catalog, or on its website or otherwise. Whenever it does so, the university will give as much advance notice as it considers feasible or appropriate, but it reserves the right in all cases to do so without notice.
Statement of Student Responsibility
Students should and are expected to read and understand the rules, requirements and policies described in the catalog. In all cases, students bear ultimate responsibility for reading the catalog and following the policies, rules, requirements, and regulations of the university.
